messages:
Nina Ortega: quick idea 1: run a compact launch for OpenKit tutorials + a tiny refapp. goal: low-friction dev onboarding + measurable bench wins.
Sam Patel: sounds good. scope? one long-form tutorial or a 3-part mini series?
Nina Ortega: 3 mini tutorials (getting started, cost/latency tweaks, production checklist) + a single reference app that demonstrates routing + caching. short blog to stitch them.
Jules Rivera: i can write the getting-started and prod-checklist. Sam, want the cost/latency one?
Sam Patel: sure. i'll do the bench narrative and a short reproducibility section. prefer to compare XR-small quantized vs baseline.
Nina Ortega: keep benchmarks lightweight. 5 seeds, 3 runs, show median. include command snippets so folks can replicate. e.g.:
```
# quick bench example
python run_microbench.py --model xr-small --seq 256 --runs 3 --seed 42
```
ContentBot: Reminder: please add `utm_source=mini_kit&utm_campaign=openkit_launch` to all links for tracking.
Jules Rivera: inbound routing: blog CTA should create a HubSpot list "openkit-mini" and tag leads with "mini_kit_launch". set nurture: email1 (how-to), email2 (bench & tips), email3 (case study + demo invite).
Sam Patel: webinar? keep it optional. a 30 min office-hours 1 week after launch for live q+a. sign-up flows into HubSpot and an event on the public calendar.
Kai M.: i can build the refapp scaffolding. plan: demo two routes (hosted API vs local private) and show how routing policy falls back on cost. small Dockerfile + quickstart script.
Nina Ortega: perfect. social assets: 1 hero image, 2 GIFs (local flow, hosted flow), and 3 tweet-sized captions. Jules can draft copy.
Jules Rivera: will draft captions. keep tone dev-friendly, example-led: "Build a low-cost reranking pipeline in 10 minutes".
Sam Patel: bench deliverables: CSV of raw timings, a short explainer section, and a reproducibility checklist. i'll add a `bench/readme.md`.
Kai M.: repo layout plan: `/tutorials/part-1-getting-started`, `/tutorials/part-2-cost`, `/refapp/` with `docker` and `deploy.md`. i'll push a draft branch by Thu.
Nina Ortega: timeline: draft tutorials by Fri EOD, bench numbers + artifacts Mon, social + blog copy Mon, webinar page Tue, launch Wed. everyone ok?
Jules Rivera: tight but doable. will prioritize the copy.
Sam Patel: fine. will run CI bench tomorrow night and post results Monday morning.
Kai M.: draft branch pushed -> i'll ping once done.
ContentBot: Action item created: content/launch/openkit-mini checklist (assign: Nina).
Nina Ortega: analytics ask: we need spike tracking for docs visits, tutorial runs (Binder + docker starts), and repo clones. Sam, can you note the key metrics in the blog so analytics can wire them?
Sam Patel: yep i'll list metrics and event names in the bench README.
Jules Rivera: marketing channels: blog, community newsletter, twitter, and dev forum cross-post. also consider a short DevRel livestream showing the refapp.
Kai M.: livestream good idea. i can demo the routing toggles live.
Nina Ortega: final thing 1: make sure codesamples are copy-paste ready and include a minimal env var config example (API_KEY VAR only). small friction points make or break adoption.
Jules Rivera: noted. i'll include a 1-file quickstart with env var example.
Sam Patel: will sanity-check numbers for the blog headline ("2x cost reduction" claims need to be defensible).
Nina Ortega: ok folks, thanks 1 i'll turn this into a Notion checklist and assign tasks. will follow-up with the launch calendar invite once blog date is locked. :sparkles:
Jules Rivera: thanks all. excited to ship this tiny kit.
Kai M.: :thumbsup:
